Streaming chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks are yielded and assembled correctly from the Converse streaming API

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 32, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count to three, one word per response.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
